values.note: $12.15 a night: the Indiana DNR's first-come, first-served primitive rate for state forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/rates-and-fees/camping-fees/ (First-Come, First-Served, 'Primitive $12.15') + https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/owen-putnam-state-forest/ ('See the fees page for a list of camping fees'), read 2026-11-02

sites.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/owen-putnam-state-forest/ ('Fish Creek Campground: 14 sites, available water'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Water during the warmer months. Picnic table, grill and parking spur at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/owen-putnam-state-forest/ ('provided with vault toilets, picnic tables, grills, and parking spurs') + https://www.in.gov/dA/a28b9519be/fo-owen-putnam-trail-map.pdf ('Water is available at Fish Creek Campground during the warmer months'), read 2026-11-02

booking.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/owen-putnam-state-forest/ ('Campsites are available on a first-come, first-serve basis; please self-register at booths located in each campground'), read 2026-11-02

note: Primitive campground in the woods west of the Owen-Putnam forest office, near a small pond and shelter. Separate horse camp and Rattlesnake campground excluded. --Claude
summary: Base $12-12.15 -> $12.15; 14 sites, FCFS, primitive confirmed; vault toilets and warm-months water added. Pin is the forest office, about 260 m off: corrected coordinates given. Not waterfront stands.
flags: PIN: 39.32084,-86.84556 is the forest office at 2153 Fish Creek Rd (Google's forest point; building and parking lot on imagery). The DNR's 'Fish Creek Campground Area' inset puts the campground west of the office, past the pond and shelter. Corrected ~39.3201,-86.8484, about 260 m west: road and end loop visible leaf-off, individual pads not.
PHONE (stored empty): 812-829-2462, on the DNR page and Google (forest: 4.6 from 199).
FIT: page silent on rig length: 'parking spurs' at each site. Couldn't measure spurs at this imagery. Reasonable to keep with no caveat beyond that.
WATER: not waterfront stands. Pond by the shelter is ~0.5 acre (measured on imagery), under the 5-acre rule, and Fish Creek is a small stream to the east. Overpass was down.
ADVISORY: 'Rattlesnake campground will be closed to vehicles until April' is another campground, not this one. SEASON not stated for this campground; left alone.
